title: Art History
description: Famous paintings, sculptures and the movements behind them

questions.question: Who painted 'The Starry Night' (1889)?
questions.explanation: Vincent van Gogh painted it while staying at an asylum in Saint-Rémy-de-Provence. It hangs at MoMA in New York.

questions.question: Which art movement takes its name from Claude Monet's painting 'Impression, Sunrise'?
questions.explanation: A critic mocked the painting's title in 1874, and the name 'Impressionism' stuck for the whole group.

questions.question: Which artist co-founded Cubism with Georges Braque?
questions.explanation: Picasso and Braque developed Cubism around 1907-1914, breaking objects into geometric facets seen from several viewpoints.

questions.question: Who painted 'The Persistence of Memory', with its melting clocks?
questions.explanation: Salvador Dalí painted it in 1931. It is a famous work of Surrealism.

questions.question: Who painted 'Girl with a Pearl Earring'?
questions.explanation: Johannes Vermeer painted it around 1665. It is in the Mauritshuis in The Hague.

questions.question: Which artist is known for 'The Scream'?
questions.explanation: Norwegian painter Edvard Munch made several versions of 'The Scream' from 1893, an icon of Expressionism.

questions.question: Which Pop Art artist made famous silkscreens of Campbell's Soup cans and Marilyn Monroe?
questions.explanation: Andy Warhol used commercial silkscreen printing to turn mass-produced images into art in the 1960s.

questions.question: Which Mexican artist is known for vivid self-portraits such as 'The Two Fridas'?
questions.explanation: Frida Kahlo painted 'The Two Fridas' in 1939. She was married to the muralist Diego Rivera.

questions.question: Who sculpted 'The Thinker'?
questions.explanation: Auguste Rodin conceived 'The Thinker' around 1880 as part of his 'Gates of Hell' commission.

questions.question: Which Dutch artist painted 'The Night Watch' (1642)?
questions.explanation: Rembrandt painted 'The Night Watch', a group portrait of a civic militia company. It is in the Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam.
